title: BHEISR: Nudging from Bias to Balance - Promoting Belief Harmony by Eliminating Ideological Segregation in Knowledge-based Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring algorithmic filter bubbles and user selective exposure through a Filter Bubbles Detection Model (FBDMR). This involves Forward Reconnaissance (FR) to compute subcategory coverage and duplicate scores for evaluating system-level preference bias, and Counter Reconnaissance (CR) to calculate user belief entropy and skewness distributions to identify user confirmation bias and ideological segregation.
